Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO) is a premier space agency in India. ISRO is responsible for the development of space technology and its application to various national tasks.

ISRO has released a notification for the recruitment of various posts. Interested candidates can apply online for these posts.

About the Programme

The ISRO Various Post Recruitment 2026 is a government job opportunity for Indian nationals. The recruitment is for various posts, including Assistant, Junior Personal Assistant, Upper Division Clerk, and Stenographer.

The objective of the programme is to select suitable candidates for these posts. The programme is open to Indian nationals who meet the eligibility criteria.
